title: eriodictyon parryi
intro: Eriodictyon parryi, commonly known as Yarrow Penstemon or Mormon Tea, is a perennial shrub native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and fighting infections due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Eriodictyon parryi are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
